The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a stable logic implementation for weighted risk assessment.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed all tests in test_output.py via pytest 8.4.1. The trial completed with zero exceptions and a mean score of 1.000 across the legacy suite. While successful, future iterations should re-check edge cases in capacity thresholds to ensure the 0.85 judge_reward can be improved toward parity with the verifier.
